title: Decision: Minimal ClientSession deserializes only fields the TUI needs
description: ClientSession (lines 34-53) declares only four fields: primaryAccounts, apiUrl, eventSourceUrl, state. The JMAP spec defines many more. By deserializing only what kith-tui uses, we ignore unknown future server fields without error. This is forward-compatible: a server upgrade that adds new capabilities doesn't break the client. The account_id() method (lines 48-52) encapsulates the capability lookup.
